title: QE Archive UI uses legacy backfill path and conflates skipped rows with failed ingestion
description: Expected: QE Archive confirmed UI writes use the audited execute path and display distinct written, skipped, and failed counts. Actual: QE pages call the legacy /api/v1/qe-archive/backfill path, which writes without creating backfill_run/backfill_run_item audit records, while frontend summaries merge skipped_reason and error into a single skipped/failed count. Users can see partial-success/failure messages and later see source-status fully archived because source-status only checks archived run presence.
reproduce_command: Use a QE page confirmed archive/write action that includes already archived, filtered, or missing loops; observe the popup aggregates skipped_reason and error as skipped/failed while /api/v1/qe-archive/source-status can later report fully_archived and no backfill_run audit is created by the legacy write route.
required_verification: frontend targeted typecheck/tests for changed QE Archive pages
closure_requirements: QE Archive confirmed UI writes use audited execute path and create backfill_run/backfill_run_item records or equivalent audit.
Execution result summaries separately report ingested, skipped, and failed counts.
Skipped rows are not displayed as failed ingestion.
Real failures remain visible and are not masked by final success status.
GitHub issue #139 and BUG-095 registry record are updated with branch, commit, and validation evidence.
